prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Select Your Pet Experience", "Choose a pre-made companion or build your own custom desktop pet.", "Choose Experience"]
1: ["Locating Your Pet on Desktop", "Your pet will spawn near your system tray once loading completes."]
2: ["Customize Your Pet Appearance", "Adjust photo framing and style filters for your custom pet.", "Upload Photo"]
3: ["Save Your New Pet", "Create or sign in to your account to save your newly adopted pet permanently."]
4: ["Essential Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn the basics to interact with your pet on screen.", "Right-click pet for settings menu", "Double-click pet to open chat window"]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Assets", "We are assembling animations and interactions for your pet."]
6: ["Your pet name is locked to your account so you can restore it anytime.", "Official Adoption Certificate"]
7: ["Welcome Your Companion Home", "Complete setup to unlock exclusive starter pet emotes!", "Starter Emotes Unlocked!"]
8: ["Make sure to sign in with the same email you used previously to keep your pets.", "Sign In to Desktop Pets"]
9: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Your new virtual companion lives right on your desktop window bar.", "Get Started"]

verdicts.problem: Promises exclusive free extras for completing setup
